Package dev.opencollab.paletter.block.component

Interface MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias

All Known Implementing Classes:
MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Alias, MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Define
Enclosing class:
MaterialInstances
public static sealed interface MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias permits MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Alias, MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Define
The value of an add-on JSON field that takes one of several forms:
  • MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Alias: the name of another instance
  • MaterialInstances.InstanceOrAlias.Define: the definition of the instance

Switch over it without a default: the records below are all its forms.

Used by: block:minecraft:material_instances:*, block:minecraft:material_instances:down, block:minecraft:material_instances:east, block:minecraft:material_instances:north, block:minecraft:material_instances:south, block:minecraft:material_instances:up, block:minecraft:material_instances:west.
